data.camera: cowboy shot, resting warhammer on ground
data.description: 【泥岩 · 雪原行军】风雪呼啸的莱塔尼亚荒原之上，穿着全套厚重萨卡兹战甲的泥岩单手扛着比人还高的巨型破城战锤，在及膝的深雪中迈着如山岳般坚实沉稳的步伐。她回头确认同伴的距离——「大家跟紧我。只要我的护盾还在，就没有任何风雪与敌人能伤到你们。」
data.promptProse: Mudrock marches steadily through the Leithanian snowfield, huge engineering warhammer over one shoulder and hazmat helmet secured over sealed olive-green power armor. She turns back to check her companions beyond the frame without breaking the stride. The cowboy view follows deep snow and wind across the exposed route. Pale snowlight illuminates armor planes and hammer edges, with cooler shadows in plate seams and the churned snow beside her path.
data.title: 泥岩 · 雪原行军
